summary.text: Karen Berg is a Democratic state senator who has represented District 26 since July 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Karen Berg earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Kentucky and an M.D. from the University of Louisville.
Her career experience includes working as a diagnostic radiologist.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Senate Health and Welfare, Licensing and Occupations, Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection, and Transportation committees.
